readOnlyFields.note: The read-only values are EditTexts with clickable=false. My Profile stays mounted under Edit Profile.

phoneLock.note: This is your login number and cannot be changed.

bmi.note: Calculated from height + weight. Updated automatically.

a11y: Delete Account, Request permanent deletion of your account and personal data

footer.note: sticky, y=2093..2240 — covers fields scrolled to the bottom edge

fields.label: Mobile number
fields.note: Used to sign in · can't be changed

fields.label: Date of birth *
fields.onFocus: clears to 'DD / MM / YYYY' and opens the app's number pad (Done key)
fields.input: digits DDMMYYYY into the FOCUSED field (addValue)

fields.label: Height (cm)
fields.note: Height and Weight labels share a row above both inputs: height is the 1st EditText below 'Height (cm)', weight the 2nd

fields.label: Emergency Contact Phone
fields.input: 10 digits without the leading 0, into the focused field

healthMetricsBadge.note: the form shows a live BMI preview while typing

allergies.note: Common examples: medicines, foods, latex, insect stings. Tap × to remove.

checkboxA11y: Diabetic Neuropathy, Nerve damage related to diabetes

conditions.othersInput: Comma Separated (disabled until Others is ticked)

passwordChange.reachedBy: Edit Profile -> Change password (inline, saved with Save Changes)
passwordChange.confirmField: NONE — no confirm-new-password field on this screen

steps: app crop screen: Navigate up · Rotate · Flip · CROP

quickLinks.appointmentLandsOn: My Appointments on the LAST-USED tab

dashboardTiles.refresh: does not update after a profile save until pull-to-refresh

stage1.DOB in the future: Date of birth can't be in the future.
stage1.emergency phone 12345 (with other errors: Invalid phone number. Please check and try again.

stage2.weight 0: Weight must be at least 1 kg
stage2.weight 999: Weight must be at most 500 kg (shown at the bottom of the form)
stage2.height 20: Height must be at least 30 cm

password.new < 8 chars: Password must be at least 8 characters.
password.empty current + valid new: Password must be at least 8 characters. (wrong message)

validation.empty DOB: reverts to the stored date on Done — no error
validation.emergency phone alone (invalid): saves with 'Profile updated' but stores nothing
